title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
description:
College athletes buy million-dollar homes, 'sudden wealth syndrome,' Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' on auction, snoring sleep partners could impact your health: Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini as they go over interesting headlines from this week.
